description: Broad QE band-solver microarchitecture catalog for evidence-plane v1 Level-1 search. Entries are provenance-backed survey/projection inputs only; catalog membership never creates a final-best claim.

entries.name: Tensor-systolic dense path
entries.summary: Device-heavy systolic tensor fabric hypothesis for h_psi/s_psi dense-block pressure and high arithmetic intensity cases.

provenance.title: F3 tensor systolic FPGA offload scaffold
provenance.notes: Local scaffold documents the candidate family and projection knobs.

provenance.title: Systolic array dataflow pattern
provenance.ref: architecture literature pattern: spatially pipelined matrix/tensor array
provenance.notes: Used only as a survey/projection pattern, not as measured evidence.

assumptions: Dense small-block operations can be batched into a regular spatial dataflow.
Host/runtime overhead and fallback remain visible in downstream B4 evidence.
No final-best claim is possible without same-candidate Stage C, strict B4, Stage D, and SystemC cycle evidence.

tile_m.description: Candidate systolic tile rows for projection sweeps.

tile_n.description: Candidate systolic tile columns for projection sweeps.

expected_effects.rationale: May reduce dense operator latency when arithmetic intensity is high.
Aggressive device offload may increase fallback exposure for irregular cases.

model_support_status.notes: Can be represented through generated SystemC architecture config sidecars before stronger evidence is collected.

entries.name: HBM streaming operator pipeline
entries.summary: Streaming memory-bandwidth-oriented pipeline hypothesis for operator application and vector movement pressure.

provenance.title: F3 HBM streaming operator pipeline scaffold
provenance.notes: Local scaffold for HBM/streaming projection semantics.

assumptions: Workload vectors can be chunked into streams with bounded host-device synchronization.
HBM effects are projection-only until a supported runtime and evidence artifacts exist.

hbm_channel_count.unknown_reason: Board/platform not selected in Stage A
hbm_channel_count.description: Physical HBM channel count requires later platform evidence.

expected_effects.rationale: May reduce stalls but can increase explicit movement if residency is weak.
May improve memory-bound operator phases when streaming is effective.

model_support_status.notes: Template metadata exists; no completed HBM runtime semantics are claimed.

entries.name: CIM + DSP vector hybrid
entries.summary: Hybrid compute-in-memory plus DSP vector datapath hypothesis for mixed operator/build workloads.

provenance.title: CIM + DSP vector hybrid scaffold
provenance.notes: Projection scaffold for hybrid CIM/DSP partitioning.

provenance.title: CIM macro block and timing contract
provenance.notes: Contract informs CIM block assumptions but is not performance measurement.

assumptions: CIM blocks are modeled as architectural resources, not measured macros.
DSP fallback remains available for unsupported precision or sparsity cases.

expected_effects.rationale: May reduce movement/energy if data residency assumptions hold.
Hybrid partition can either reduce spills or increase pressure if CIM capacity is insufficient.

model_support_status.notes: Hybrid semantics are proposal metadata pending executor support.

entries.name: Near-memory PIM resident context
entries.summary: Near-memory/PIM resident-context hypothesis for reducing repeated vector and subspace movement.

provenance.title: Near-memory PIM resident scaffold
provenance.notes: Local projection scaffold for resident/PIM behavior.

assumptions: Resident context fits important subspace/vector state for selected workloads.
PIM behavior is not supported by the current executor and must stay survey/projection-only.

memory_stack_topology.description: Package topology requires future platform evidence.

expected_effects.rationale: Resident context may reduce repeated host/device transfers.
Unsupported resident behavior may increase fallback if capacity assumptions fail.

model_support_status.notes: No completed runtime executor or board support; keep as broad catalog/projection only.

entries.name: CGRA dataflow operator fabric
entries.summary: Coarse-grained reconfigurable dataflow fabric hypothesis for shared operator/build scheduling.

provenance.title: F5 CGRA dataflow operator scaffold
provenance.notes: Local scaffold documents dataflow projection semantics.

assumptions: Operator/build kernels can be scheduled over coarse-grained dataflow nodes.
Runtime scheduling support is future work and cannot be inferred from template metadata.

expected_effects.rationale: May improve fused multi-stage scheduling if mapping succeeds.
Large fabric may increase resource and routing risk.

model_support_status.notes: No current CGRA executor; catalog and projection only.

entries.name: Multi-chiplet NoC partition
entries.summary: Multi-chiplet/interposer NoC partition hypothesis for aggressive memory and compute distribution.

provenance.title: Multi-chiplet NoC partition scaffold
provenance.notes: Local scaffold for communication and partition projection.

assumptions: Communication costs can be represented as projection parameters in Level-1 search.
No package, board, or ASIC evidence exists for this entry.

noc_bandwidth_gbps.description: Physical NoC bandwidth requires later platform evidence.

expected_effects.rationale: Partitioning may localize data or add inter-chiplet traffic.
Packaging/interconnect assumptions are high risk without physical evidence.

model_support_status.notes: No current multi-chiplet executor or physical package evidence.

entries.name: Fused build/diagonalization cluster
entries.summary: Fused reduced-build plus diagonalization cluster hypothesis for reducing intermediate movement between B and C stages.

provenance.title: QE kernel characterization matrix
provenance.notes: Informs stage pressure only, not measured fused performance.

assumptions: Reduced-build outputs can feed diagonalization without excessive format conversion.
Fused-stage scheduling remains projection-only until runtime evidence exists.

diag_fallback_threshold.description: Threshold requires Stage C and B4 closure.

expected_effects.rationale: Fusion may reduce intermediate movement between build and diag.
Aggressive fusion can increase fallback for difficult diagonalization cases.

model_support_status.notes: Template projection exists; no completed fused executor semantics are claimed.
